name: Clock
description: A native clock — alarms and timers your agent sets for itself, and you set in the GUI.
about: Clatch has no cron; a scheduler is just an app that fires signals. Clock is that app, built like a real clock: a live analog face, drum-wheel alarms, and a countdown timer. The agent schedules its own alarms and timers over the CLI, the human sets them in the GUI, and when one is due it fires a run-type signal that wakes the agent(s) the alarm targets — chosen in the GUI (or with --to), defaulting to whoever set it.

commands.name: list
commands.about: list all alarms and timers, with who set/wakes each

commands.name: alarm
commands.about: set an alarm at HH:MM; --note is your prompt when it wakes you, --repeat daily|weekdays|weekends, --to picks which agent(s) it wakes, --quiet notifies without a turn

commands.name: timer
commands.about: start a countdown (10m, 1h30m, 90s) — fires timer.done when it ends

commands.name: cancel
commands.about: remove an alarm or timer by id (aN alarm · tN timer)
